motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Control feedback; omitted timing function uses CSS ease.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: In-page navigation; scroll padding is 6rem, or 5rem at 760px.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All element/pseudo-element transitions become none !important; scrolling becomes auto.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Main signup action. Samples inherit page tokens with light fallbacks. Dark appearance overrides hover to #ffe09a in the source stylesheet.

components.name: Compact button
components.description: Compact filled action in navigation; minimum height 44px.

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Secondary plan action, filled on hover.

components.name: Labeled input
components.description: Shared contact/calculator field treatment: 16px input type, 48px minimum height, .875rem desktop labels and 16px mobile labels. The 3px focus outline uses a 2px offset.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Email address<input class="ds-input" type="email" autocomplete="email" required></label>

components.name: Navigation links
components.description: Desktop links and mobile vertical arrangement. The source header adds the original logo and compact CTA; its JavaScript owns disclosure and Escape focus handling.

components.name: Pricing panel
components.description: Flat bordered plan surface; Growth receives butter fill. Flex columns and auto top margins keep CTAs aligned at the bottom of the desktop row. Sample excludes plan prices and entitlements pending product verification.

components.name: Calculator result panel
components.description: Static visual excerpt of the flat illustrative calculator. The source heading uses cookie-batch.webp; its JavaScript updates costs, labels losses as “Batch loss” with an absolute amount, validates numeric bounds, and announces results through a polite atomic live region. “Reset example” restores defaults and is hidden without JavaScript. At 380px, result labels reserve 3.3em to align output baselines.

components.css: .ds-calculator{padding:32px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dfd1bf);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#342019);font:400 1rem/1.65 var(--font,Manrope,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-results{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:28px;padding:22px;border-radius:var(--radius,8px);background:var(--butter,#f7ce69)}.ds-results span{display:block;font-size:.875rem}.ds-results output{display:block;font-size:2rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-results p{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0;font-size:.875rem}.ds-note{margin:16px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#6d574a);font-size:.8rem}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-calculator{padding:24px}.ds-results{padding:18px}.ds-results span,.ds-results p{font-size:1rem}.ds-results output{font-size:1.8rem}}@media(max-width:380px){.ds-calculator{padding:20px}.ds-results{padding:16px;gap:12px}.ds-results span{min-height:3.3em}.ds-results output{font-size:1.5rem}}

narrative.overview:
Butter-yellow fields, cocoa ink, generous Manrope type, simple rounded controls, and tactile bakery photography make the business side of home baking feel manageable. The original KneadIt logo anchors an open, editorial page with a working illustrative calculator. Positioning is integrated into the hero's introductory paragraph.

This draft records the code-led, one-page Jigsaw implementation in `source/index.blade.php`, `source/css/marketing.css`, and `source/js/marketing.mjs`, including refinements to the user's accepted visual direction, informed by `PRODUCT.md`. It supersedes the stale paper-and-forest / DM Sans description without introducing a new direction. Status: **refinement ready for review; not deployed**. No comp exists; acceptance of the visual direction does not imply final refinement approval. Plan prices and entitlements are intentionally excluded pending reconciliation with application configuration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm tonal sections and restrained borders.
One self-hosted type family with bold, tightly spaced headings.
Original branding, generated illustrative bakery photos, and a usable costing example.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: When reduced motion is requested, disable transitions and use automatic scrolling instead of smooth scrolling.

dos: Do preserve the original KneadIt logo and the self-hosted Manrope family.
Do keep focus indicators, visible field labels, reduced-motion handling, and non-JavaScript fallbacks.
Do label generated imagery and calculator examples honestly; keep application behavior outside the static landing page.
donts: Don't reintroduce the stale paper-and-forest / DM Sans direction as the current system.
Don't imply customer endorsement, verified earnings, comp approval, or deployment from this documentation.
